tasks.label: KBP4: Make macOS Installer (Signed, Skip Notarize)
tasks.detail: Signed universal DMG, notarization skipped — fast local check.

tasks.label: KBP4: Make macOS Installer (Signed + Notarized)
tasks.detail: Full release build: sync-renderer → sign app → package DMG → sign DMG → notarize + staple → regenerate channel metadata. Requires .env with APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE.

tasks.label: KBP4: Notarize Existing macOS DMG
tasks.detail: Reuses the already-built app + DMG in release/ and signs/notarizes/staples it. Requires .env with APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE.

tasks.label: KBP4: Make Windows Installer (Signed)
tasks.detail: Requires local signtool.exe and the KMI Music, Inc. code-signing cert (see apps/desktop/signWindows.js).

tasks.label: KBP4: Publish macOS Release to GitHub
tasks.detail: Uploads the already-built, already-tested DMG from release/. Build + test it first. Requires gh CLI authenticated.

tasks.label: KBP4: Publish Windows Release to GitHub
tasks.detail: Uploads the already-built, already-tested installer from release/. Build + test it first. Requires gh CLI authenticated.
